passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should consider each of the following factors in evaluating our business and our prospects, any of which could negatively impact our business, results of operations, cash flows and financial condition, and require significant management time and attention. Further, the risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently consider immaterial may also negatively impact our business, results of operations, cash flows and financial condition, and require significant management time and attention. In such cases, the trading price of our common stock could decline. You should also consider the other information set forth in this Annual Report in evaluating our business and our prospects, including but not limited to our financial statements and the related notes, and “Part II, Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.” References to “and,” “or” and “and/or” should be read to include the others, as appropriate. Risk Factors Summary: RISKS RELATED TO REVENUE AND CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION • We derive a significant portion of our revenues from a small number of mobile handset customers and licensees, and particularly from their sale of premium-tier handset devices. If revenues derived from these customers or licensees decrease or the timing of such revenues fluctuates, our business and results of operations could be negatively affected. • Our business, particularly our semiconductor business, may suffer as a result of our customers vertically integrating (i.e., developing their own integrated circuit products). • A significant portion of our business is concentrated in China, and the risks of such concentration are exacerbated by U.S./China trade and national security tensions. RISKS RELATED TO DIVERSIFICATION AND OTHER STRATEGIC INITIATIVES • Our growth depends in part on the continued expansion of our business in industries and applications beyond mobile handsets, including in automotive, the internet of things (IoT) and data center. Our research, development and other investments in these areas, and related technologies and products, may not generate operating income or contribute to future results of operations that meet our expectations. • Our increasing focus on artificial intelligence (AI), including on-device AI, agentic AI and AI infrastructure, may not result in the anticipated benefits and could expose us to additional competitive, regulatory, intellectual property and operational risks. 14 • We may engage in acquisitions and other strategic transactions or make investments, or be unable to consummate planned strategic acquisitions, which could adversely affect our results of operations or fail to enhance stockholder value. RISKS RELATED TO INDUSTRY DYNAMICS AND COMPETITION • Our revenues depend on our customers’ and licensees’ sales of products and services based on cellular communications and other technologies, and increasingly on customer demand for our products and platform solutions in automotive, IoT and data center. • The semiconductor industry is subject to intense competition in

credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds share repurchases, and free cash flow also covers buybacks, so distributions are funded from internally generated cash rather than incremental borrowing. This supports the minimal indicative financial risk profile and gives the issuer flexibility to absorb a cyclical downturn in handset demand.

Gross leverage sits below the sector median and net leverage on a cash-and-short-investment basis remains modest, with substantial headroom to the next risk-band boundary. Interest coverage and cash-flow-to-debt both exceed sector medians, reflecting a debt load that is small relative to the earnings and cash generation of the licensing and chipset franchise.

key_risks.text: Revenue concentration in a small number of premium-tier handset customers and licensees, together with customer vertical integration and heavy China exposure, is the central disclosed risk. A shift in design wins or trade restrictions could compress licensing and chipset revenue quickly, and the annual trend already shows operating income and operating cash flow declining from the prior year.

The debt note shows a large fixed-rate note stack maturing beyond the near term, with a meaningful principal repayment due within the next year and commercial paper outstanding at short weighted-average maturity. Refinancing depends on continued access to unsecured markets, and the commercial paper program must be rolled or repaid from liquidity.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains strong and above the sector median, although it has fallen from the prior year as operating income declined while interest expense persisted. Cash interest paid is modest relative to operating cash flow, so debt service consumes only a small share of internally generated funds and leaves room for capital expenditure and distributions.

Liquidity is adequate: the current ratio exceeds the sector median and cash balances, together with an undrawn revolving facility, cover near-term maturities. Free cash flow to debt is above the sector median, indicating the debt stock could be retired from cash generation within a reasonable period absent a sharp earnings shock.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with leverage below the sector median and cash-flow coverage above it. The balance sheet is conservatively financed with unsecured fixed-rate notes and no secured borrowing, and free cash flow after capital expenditure comfortably funds shareholder returns, in our judgement supporting a strong investment-grade-like credit posture.

The main credit sensitivities are revenue concentration and China exposure rather than financial policy, and the year-over-year decline in operating margin and cash flow warrants monitoring. We view the margin compression as cyclical rather than structural, but a sustained earnings decline would erode the currently ample headroom to the next leverage threshold.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流穩健地超過股份回購，自由現金流亦足以覆蓋回購，因此分派乃由內部產生之現金而非增量借貸提供資金。此支持最低限度之指示性財務風險狀況，並給予發行人靈活性以吸收手機需求之週期性下滑。
總槓桿低於行業中位數，按現金及短期投資計算之淨槓桿維持溫和，距下一風險區間邊界有充裕緩衝。利息覆蓋率及現金流對債務比率均高於行業中位數，反映債務負擔相對於授權及晶片組業務之盈利與現金產生能力而言較小。

key_risks.text: 收入集中於少數高端手機客戶及被授權方，加上客戶垂直整合及高度之中國敞口，為所披露之核心風險。設計訂單之轉變或貿易限制可能迅速壓縮授權及晶片組收入，而年度趨勢已顯示營業收入及營運現金流較上一年度下降。
債務附註顯示大量固定利率票據於近期之後到期，未來一年內有可觀之本金償還，而商業票據之加權平均到期期限較短。再融資取決於能否持續進入無抵押市場，而商業票據計劃須以流動性滾動或償還。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率維持強勁並高於行業中位數，儘管因營業收入下降而利息支出持續，該比率已較上一年度下降。已付現金利息相對於營運現金流而言溫和，故債務償付僅佔內部產生資金之小部分，並為資本開支及分派留有空間。
流動性充足：流動比率高於行業中位數，現金結餘連同未提取之循環融資額度覆蓋近期到期債務。自由現金流對債務比率高於行業中位數，表明在無盈利急劇衝擊之情況下，債務存量可於合理期間內以現金產生能力償還。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈現最低限度之指示性財務風險狀況，槓桿低於行業中位數而現金流覆蓋率則高於該水平。資產負債表以無抵押固定利率票據審慎融資，並無有抵押借款，而資本開支後之自由現金流穩健地為股東回報提供資金，吾等認為此支持強勁之近似投資級信用狀況。
主要信用敏感因素為收入集中及中國敞口而非財務政策，而營業利潤率及現金流之按年下降值得監察。吾等視利潤率壓縮為週期性而非結構性，但盈利持續下降將侵蝕目前距下一槓桿門檻之充裕緩衝。
